note: model_class form: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file using the global RNG (called by the evaluator after set_seed). This file records the shape family fixed by get_inputs as the machine-readable version of the task-prompt contract; tolerance and global shape constraints are in task.yaml.

shape_family.lengths: random (global RNG): L ~ U[1, 256], total is variable-length
shape_family.num_targets: random (global RNG): g ~ U[1, 20] truncated to g <= L
